messages:
alex: Heads-up 1: prospective client (FinServCo) wants an on-prem, air-gapped pilot. Must support signed delta bundles, SBOM, deterministic build notes, and a 6-month planned patch cadence but allow emergency hotfixes within 48h. Also asks for offline license transfer and per-node billing.
riley: Do they require physical media? Or is a jumpbox with SCP acceptable?
alex: They said hardware delivery is possible but prefer jumpbox + ephemeral USB delivery only for final cutoff. Compliance tight on transport logs.
nina: From engineering: we can create base minibundle (~3.2GB) plus deltas ~80-350MB depending on quantization. Need to confirm model variant; quantization for 8-bit reduces size but adds post-processing signing step.
carlos: Ops concerns 1: verification flow needs to be machine-readable. We'll produce a signed manifest + detached signature (PKCS7) and a checksum file. Need to allow offline signature verification instructions.
ops-bot: release 20241115-airgap pushed: //releases.redwood/airgap/20241115-rc2 (signed) :package: 
riley: Security question: will the signing key be HSM-held? They want attestation that signing keys are in an HSM and rotation policy.
nina: We have two options: (a) sign in our HSM and provide signed artifacts; (b) provide materials so customer can sign with their own HSM during install. Option (b) requires a signing hook in the installer and an unsigned bundle path. Both supported but docs differ.
alex: Commercial asks 1: propose one-time airgap engineering fee + yearly offline support. Suggested starting point: $12,500 one-time + $300/node/year. Please confirm margins.
carlos: Implementation notes: building quantized model adds ~45-90min to pipeline; if we add reproducible builds/attestations expect add'l 20min. That affects delivery if they want weekly deltas. Recommend monthly deltas plus urgent hotfixes only.
riley: Compliance will ask for SBOM format (CycloneDX or SPDX) and checksums per component. Also need supply-chain statement describing build environment and versions.
ops-bot: checklist created: airgap-install-README.md, signed-manifest-format.md, sbom-cyclonedx.xml template.
nina: I'll calculate final bundle sizes for both int8 and int4 models and post here tomorrow.
carlos: I'll draft the offline install runbook + verification checklist. Include steps: checksum verify, signature verify (openssl cms -verify), and service smoke test.
alex: Action items: @nina size calc (tomorrow), @carlos runbook (48h), @riley security Qs draft (EOD), commercial to confirm pricing. We'll set a sync with FinServCo once we have manifest + price.
riley: Also note: logistics 1: if physical USBs used, we must provide tamper-evident packaging and chain-of-custody form. I can draft a template.
alex: Great. I'll update the AE and schedule a call for next week. :thumbsup:
